The parameter is a configuration key, not a record id: own is an existing key (general.company_name), foreign a second existing key (ui.theme.primary_color), missing a well-formed key no row has, malformed a key with characters no key uses; the handler rejects no key by its form, so malformed is looked up like missing.

The parameter is a category name, not a record id: own is an existing category (general), foreign a second one (leads), missing a well-formed name no entry has, malformed a name with characters no category uses; the handler rejects no name and an unknown category is an empty list.
Two parameters: the customer is the caller's own customer record in every case and the mapping id varies; foreign is an existing mapping of another customer.
Two parameters: the product is the first seeded product in every case (products have no owner) and the mapping id varies; foreign is an existing mapping of the second product.
